ccd.fluid_arm.configured: Configured %s inputs, %s outputs; skipped %s invalid targets
ccd.package.use_packager: Unload this Copper Package with a Fluid Packager
ccd.package.address.read_only: Cannot write to a read-only Clipboard
ccd.package.address.missing: No unchecked address on this page
ccd.fluid_stock.name: Fluid Marker (%s)
ccd.gauge.amount_tip: Click and hold for target amount
ccd.smart_collection_grate.paused: Collection and output paused by redstone
ccd.gauge.target_amount.tooltip: Enter 0–100000 mB. 1000 mB is one bucket; 0 monitors only.
ccd.configuration.boosterPump.tooltip: Server-side settings for Booster Pumps. Changes need a world reload.
ccd.configuration.fluidArm.tooltip: Server-side settings for the Pipetting Arm. Changes need a world reload.
ccd.configuration.smartTank.tooltip: Server-side settings for Smart Fluid Tanks. Changes need a world reload.
ccd.configuration.waterSupply.tooltip: Server-side settings for the Conduit Box. Changes need a world reload.
ccd.configuration.atomizer.tooltip: Server-side settings for the Fluid Atomizer. Changes need a world reload.
ccd.configuration.boosterPump.stressMult: How much _Stress_ this pump draws, relative to a Mechanical Pump at the same speed.
ccd.configuration.boosterPump.pressureMu: _Pumping pressure_ relative to a Mechanical Pump at the same speed; this sets the flow.
ccd.configuration.boosterPump.rangeMulti: Multiplies the _range_ of a Mechanical Pump, applied to each side separately.
ccd.configuration.fluidArm.allowDirectCo: Off: the arm must load and unload through _Fluid Hatches_. On: it may target a container face directly.
ccd.configuration.smartTank.maxFluidType: How many _fluid types_ one structure holds. Vertical and horizontal count separately; lowering it never deletes stored fluid.
ccd.configuration.waterSupply.rate.toolt: Automatic supply in _mB/tick_, handed out in bursts. -1 fills as far as it can, 0 turns automatic supply off. Manual use is unaffected.
ccd.configuration.atomizer.normalConsump: Fluid spent while spraying, in _mB/s_; custom atomizer recipes may set their own.
ccd.configuration.atomizer.potionConsump: Fluid spent while spraying potions, in _mB/s_; custom recipes may set their own.
block.ccd.booster_pump.tooltip.summary: Pushes fluid _further_ and _harder_, and charges you Stress for the privilege.
block.ccd.booster_pump.tooltip.behaviour: Pipes on the ends, shafts on the four sides. Reverse the _rotation_ and the flow follows.
block.ccd.fluid_transmitter.tooltip.summ: Fluid crosses to the other side _without a single rotation_.
block.ccd.fluid_transmitter.tooltip.beha: Fluid leaves along the _arrows_. A straight chain shares one allowance.
_Pauses_ transfer. The side filter decides what may pass.
block.ccd.redstone_fluid_valve.tooltip.s: A pipe you can _shut_ with a signal.
block.ccd.redstone_fluid_valve.tooltip.b: Signal _opens_ it, no signal _closes_ it. A pump still has to move the fluid.
block.ccd.three_way_valve.tooltip.summar: _Sends_ one pipe's fluid down a different branch.
block.ccd.three_way_valve.tooltip.behavi: The silver _common port_ meets the opposite _straight port_.
The common port turns to the _side port_. Green marks the branch; the pump sets the flow.
block.ccd.three_way_valve.tooltip.action: Turns the branch, or the whole valve.
block.ccd.faucet.tooltip.summary: _Tips_ fluid downwards and keeps none for itself.
block.ccd.faucet.tooltip.condition1: With a Container or Cauldron Below
block.ccd.faucet.tooltip.behaviour1: Draws from the _container behind_ and fills downward, stopping when the target is full.
block.ccd.faucet.tooltip.behaviour2: _Pauses_ the flow and leaves the manual toggle alone.
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.summary: _Tips_ fluid downwards, and spares a drop for whatever passes below.
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.condition: With a Container or Cauldron Below
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.behaviour: Draws from the _container behind_ and fills downward, stopping when the target is full.
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.condition: With a Belt or Depot Two Blocks Below
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.behaviour: Keep the block between clear and it runs _Spout filling recipes_.
_Pauses_ the flow and leaves the manual toggle alone.
block.ccd.fluid_packager.tooltip.summary: _Boxes up_ fluid and mails it to the next base.
block.ccd.fluid_packager.tooltip.behavio: Up to _4000 mB_ per package. Redstone fills it up; logistics packs the _requested amount_.
Waits until the container can take the whole payload at once.
block.ccd.fluid_packager.tooltip.action1: Samples a _fluid filter_ without drinking the sample. Only redstone packing obeys it.
item.ccd.fluid_stock.tooltip.summary: Tells the gauge _which fluid_ you want. Each count is _1 mB_.
item.ccd.fluid_stock.tooltip.behaviour1: It is only a request; the fluid itself rides in _Copper Packages_.
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.summary: Watches the stock and _reorders_ before you run dry.
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.condition1: When Attached to a Receiving Packager
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.behaviour1: Keeps the container behind at its _target stock_, counting deliveries already on the way.
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.control1: R-Click a Stock Link Before Placing
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.control2: Tap R-Click with a Fluid Sample
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.action2: Picks the _fluid_ to watch or request.
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.control3: Hold R-Click, or Open the Settings
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.action3: Sets the target, down to _exact mB_. Zero means watch only.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.summary: A mechanical arm that _carries fluid around_ for you, _1000 mB_ a trip.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.behaviour1: It picks the _front of Fluid Hatches_ by default.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.behaviour2: _Stops picking up_. What it already carries still gets delivered, or held if blocked.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.action1: Cycles _input_, _output_ and off. Sneak-right-click removes it.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.control2: R-Click an Arm with the Arm Item
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.action2: Applies the selected targets; sneak-right-click clears them.
block.ccd.fluid_hatch.tooltip.summary: _Reach through a wall_ for the fluid behind it.
block.ccd.fluid_hatch.tooltip.behaviour1: Work from the exposed _front_; the container face keeps its own restrictions.
block.ccd.fluid_hatch.tooltip.control1: R-Click with a Bucket, Bottle or Fluid Container
block.ccd.fluid_hatch.tooltip.action1: Tries to _pour in_ first, then to _draw out_.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_hatch.tooltip.summ: Reaches through the wall and _turns away_ what should not pass.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_hatch.tooltip.beha: Work from the exposed _front_; the container face keeps its own restrictions.
_Nothing gets through_ until a filter is set.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_hatch.tooltip.cont: R-Click with a Bucket, Bottle or Fluid Container
block.ccd.smart_fluid_hatch.tooltip.acti: Tries to _pour in_ first, then to _draw out_.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_tank.tooltip.summa: Several fluids share _one tank_ and never mix.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_tank.tooltip.behav: A _1×1, 2×2 or 3×3_ cross-section; adding height merges the capacity.
Without a filter it draws the _first fluid_ in the goggles list.
block.ccd.horizontal_smart_fluid_tank.to: Several fluids share _one tank_ and never mix, laid out sideways.
A _1×1, 2×2 or 3×3_ cross-section; extending it merges the capacity.
Without a filter it draws the _first fluid_ in the goggles list.
block.ccd.copper_water_basin.tooltip.sum: Water that never runs out, however many buckets you take.
block.ccd.copper_water_basin.tooltip.beh: Whatever is poured in gets _discarded_; the basin stays pure water.
block.ccd.copper_water_basin.tooltip.act: _Fills_ anything that takes water, without displacing another fluid.
block.ccd.copper_water_basin.tooltip.con: Sneak + R-Click with a Filled Container
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.su: An endless well that _reaches out_ to water its neighbours.
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.be: Whatever is poured in gets _discarded_; the supply stays pure water.
Only _automatic supply_ pauses; hands and pipes still work.
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.ac: _Fills_ anything that takes water, without displacing another fluid.
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.co: Sneak + R-Click with a Filled Container
block.ccd.copper_collection_grate.toolti: Catches what lands on top and sends it _below_.
Slowly drains the _whole connected pool_, stopping when full. Dripstone drips count too.
block.ccd.smart_collection_grate.tooltip: Catches what lands on top and passes on _only what you allow_.
Slowly drains the _whole connected pool_, stopping when full. Dripstone drips count too.
Automatic collection and output pause; pipes and hands still work.
Only matching fluid is taken, though what is stored can still drain. Empty filters take all.
item.ccd.copper_bucket.tooltip.summary: A big bucket: _4000 mB_ of _one fluid_, no mixing.
item.ccd.copper_bucket.tooltip.behaviour: _1000 mB_ at a time, source blocks only. Creative placement keeps the contents.
item.ccd.copper_bucket.tooltip.action2: _Empties_ into a container, or forces world placement.
item.ccd.honeycomb_mold.tooltip.summary: A mold you keep reusing to press honey into _honeycomb_.
item.ccd.honeycomb_mold.tooltip.behaviou: A Press spends _250 mB_ of honey and _hands the mold back_.
item.minecraft.powder_snow_bucket.toolti: Powder snow is a fluid too: _stored, pumped and mailed_, _1000 mB_ a bucket.
Becomes a _freezing medium_ once a compatible addon is installed.
item.ccd.quicksand_bucket.tooltip.summar: Sand, stirred into a _sanding medium_ you can bucket, pump and mail.
item.ccd.quicksand_bucket.tooltip.behavi: Runs _Sandpaper Polishing recipes_ in bulk, without a single sheet of sandpaper.
item.ccd.quicksand_bucket.tooltip.action: Spends _1000 mB_ to form a sanding catalyst, where that feature is enabled.
item.ccd.fluid_package.tooltip.condition: When Fed into a Fluid Packager
item.ccd.fluid_package.tooltip.behaviour: _Empties_ its fluid into the attached container.
item.ccd.fluid_package.tooltip.action1: R-Click in the inventory to _copy the address_, L-Click to _paste_.
item.ccd.composite_package.tooltip.summa: One package that carries _both_ items and fluid.
item.ccd.composite_package.tooltip.behav: _Merges_ items and fluids from the same order.
item.ccd.composite_package.tooltip.actio: _Returns the items_ and splits the fluid into _Copper Packages_.
block.ccd.fluid_access_port.tooltip.summ: Opens _every face_ of the container it touches.
block.ccd.fluid_access_port.tooltip.beha: All six faces work. Ports and Bridges _cannot extend each other_.
block.ccd.fluid_bridge.tooltip.summary: One connection that reaches _containers on both sides_.
block.ccd.fluid_bridge.tooltip.behaviour: That end only passes _matching fluid_; a set filter beats an empty one at the other end.
block.ccd.fluid_bridge.tooltip.control1: When R-Clicked on an End Face
block.ccd.fluid_atomizer.tooltip.summary: _Laces_ the air current so the fan can do something new.
block.ccd.fluid_atomizer.tooltip.behavio: Spends stored _fluid_ to give the current its _processing effect_.
Entities in the current catch the _potion effects_.
block.ccd.fluid_atomizer.tooltip.control: When R-Clicked with a Fluid Container
block.ccd.fluid_atomizer.tooltip.action1: _Inserts_ or _extracts_ fluid. Pipes connect on the four sides.
item.ccd.seething_reagent_bucket.tooltip: When Supplied to a Fluid Atomizer
The air current now runs _Seething_ recipes.
item.ccd.enriching_reagent_bucket.toolti: When Supplied to a Fluid Atomizer
The air current now runs _Enriching_ recipes.
item.ccd.soul_stripping_reagent_bucket.t: A fluid that grants _Soul Stripping_ processing.
When Supplied to a Fluid Atomizer
The air current now runs _Soul Stripping_ recipes.
item.ccd.explosive_slurry_bucket.tooltip: When Supplied to a Fluid Atomizer
The air current now runs _Exploding_ recipes.
item.ccd.resonant_solution_bucket.toolti: When Supplied to a Fluid Atomizer
The air current now runs _Resonant_ recipes.
item.ccd.sculk_suspension_bucket.tooltip: When Supplied to a Fluid Atomizer
The air current now runs _Sculking_ recipes.
item.ccd.purifying_solution_bucket.toolt: When Supplied to a Fluid Atomizer
The air current now runs _Purifying_ recipes.
ccd.ponder.fluid_packaging.text_1: Set the back of a Fluid Packager against a container
ccd.ponder.fluid_packaging.text_2: A redstone signal packs up to 4000 mB into a Copper Package
ccd.ponder.fluid_packaging.text_3: Packages take addresses and travel just like ordinary ones
ccd.ponder.fluid_packaging.text_4: Arriving packages empty into the container behind
ccd.ponder.fluid_packaging.text_5: Sample a filled container to set the packing filter
ccd.ponder.fluid_packaging.text_6: A Repackager merges items and fluids into Brass Packages
ccd.ponder.fluid_hatches.text_1: A hatch exposes the container it is mounted on
ccd.ponder.fluid_hatches.text_2: Right-click the front with a filled container to pour or draw
ccd.ponder.fluid_hatches.text_3: Smart hatches only let the fluid you picked through
ccd.ponder.fluid_hatches.text_4: Mark hatch fronts as inputs and outputs before placing the arm
ccd.ponder.fluid_hatches.text_5: Add rotation afterwards and it carries fluid between those points
ccd.ponder.fluid_access.text_1: An Access Port opens every face of the container it is attached to
ccd.ponder.fluid_access.text_2: Access Ports and Fluid Bridges cannot extend each other
ccd.ponder.fluid_access.text_3: A Fluid Bridge reaches the containers at both of its ends
ccd.ponder.fluid_access.text_4: The end that has a filter wins, even when the other end is empty
ccd.ponder.smart_tanks.text_1: Smart Fluid Tanks next to each other share one capacity
ccd.ponder.smart_tanks.text_3: Horizontal tanks extend along the axis they were placed on
ccd.ponder.smart_tanks.text_4: Different fluids stay apart while the capacity is shared
ccd.ponder.smart_tanks.text_5: A Wrench toggles the observation windows
ccd.ponder.fluid_faucets.text_1: Clip a faucet to the side of a container
ccd.ponder.fluid_faucets.text_2: Open it and the container directly below fills up
ccd.ponder.fluid_faucets.text_3: Smart Faucets also fill items on a Belt or Depot two blocks down
ccd.ponder.fluid_atomizing.header: Putting fluid into the air current
ccd.ponder.fluid_atomizing.text_1: Rotation goes in at the back, fluid at the sides
ccd.ponder.fluid_atomizing.text_2: A filled container works too, by hand
ccd.ponder.fluid_atomizing.text_3: Whatever it holds decides which processing the air carries
ccd.ponder.fluid_atomizing.text_4: Redstone stops the spray, not the air current
ccd.ponder.fluid_switching.text_1: The silver port is shared by both routes
ccd.ponder.fluid_switching.text_2: Without redstone the common port meets the straight port
ccd.ponder.fluid_switching.text_3: With redstone it turns to the side port instead
ccd.ponder.fluid_switching.text_4: The pump still decides which way the fluid goes
ccd.ponder.fluid_collection.text_1: A grate collects fluid resting on its top face
ccd.ponder.fluid_collection.text_2: What it collects drains into the container below
ccd.ponder.fluid_collection.text_3: Smart grates add a fluid filter and a redstone switch
ccd.ponder.fluid_collection.text_4: A Conduit Box waters every container it touches
ccd.ponder.fluid_collection.text_5: A Copper Water Basin has water to take, but never pushes it
ccd.ponder.fluid_transfer.text_1: A Transmitter moves fluid next door without rotation
ccd.ponder.fluid_transfer.text_2: The arrows on the housing point at the receiving side
ccd.ponder.fluid_transfer.text_3: A Wrench turns the direction around
ccd.ponder.fluid_transfer.text_4: A redstone signal makes it pause
ccd.ponder.booster_pumping.text_1: A Booster Pump drives fluid along the pipes it is attached to
ccd.ponder.booster_pumping.text_2: Its direction marks point at the outlet
ccd.ponder.booster_pumping.text_3: A Wrench reverses the pumping direction
ccd.ponder.booster_pumping.text_4: More pressure and more range cost more Stress Impact
block.ccd.fluid_access_port.tooltip.beha: Access closes; a Comparator repeats the container's signal instead.
block.ccd.fluid_bridge.tooltip.behaviour: Both ends close; a Comparator outputs half the sum of their signals.
